title: Loss of NCOA6 protein causes aggressive prostate cancer with EGFR overexpression and dependency.
snippet: Loss of tumor suppressors can drive carcinogenesis while simultaneously creating actionable therapeutic vulnerabilities. Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is frequently overexpressed in prostate cancer (PCa), yet EGFR inhibitors have shown limited clinical benefit, and the basis for this variability remains unclear.
